title: Earliest Finish Time for Land and Water Rides I
description:
You are given two types of rides:

Land rides
Water rides

Each ride has:

a start time (when it opens)
a duration (how long it takes)

You must:

Take exactly one land ride and one water ride
You can take them in any order

Rules:

You can start a ride at its start time or later
If you finish one ride, you can:
start the next immediately (if it’s open), or
wait until it opens

Return the earliest time you can finish both rides.

Example 1
Input:
landStartTime = [2, 8], landDuration = [4, 1]
waterStartTime = [6], waterDuration = [3]

Output: 9

Explanation:
Best plan → Land ride (2→6), then Water ride (6→9)

Example 2
Input:
landStartTime = [5], landDuration = [3]
waterStartTime = [1], waterDuration = [10]

Output: 14

Explanation:
Best plan → Water ride (1→11), then Land ride (11→14)

Constraints:

1 <= n, m <= 100
1 <= startTime, duration <= 1000
input_format: Read from standard input. Format details depends on the problem.
